reviews.text: Hurst Pool Service did a fantastic job cleaning and refreshing our 30-year-old pool. Now it looks sparkling clean and modern, and we’re really happy with the wall and trim tiles we chose. Jared and the whole team were friendly, easy to work with, and showed great skill and professionalism. They make sure their pool cleaning work is top-notch and are quick to help if anything needs attention. I would highly recommend them for any pool cleaning or maintenance needs.
reviews.author: Bonnie Farmer

reviews.text: Hurst Pool Service did an outstanding job taking care of my pool. Wayne was very knowledgeable, professional, and made sure everything was handled with care. They fixed the plaster, replaced the DE filters, swapped out leaky gaskets, changed the pool lights, and got my Polaris running perfectly again. They even installed a new spa blower and replaced the jacuzzi switch, something I was told couldn't be done without breaking up the concrete—but they managed it without any trouble. All the work, including several other small repairs, was completed quickly and at a fair price. I'm really happy with the whole experience and would definitely recommend them to anyone in Hurst looking for reliable pool service.
reviews.author: Florence S

reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Hurst Pool Service. After hearing some horror stories from friends about other pool companies, I was relieved that nothing like that happened here. Every team that worked on my pool was professional and made sure to clean up the area each day. They even protected my house so no pool materials would get on it. My first meeting with Dillon for the pool design was very easy and stress-free. After that, Harold managed the project all the way through completion, keeping me updated on what was happening next and quickly handling any questions I had. I always felt confident with Harold in charge. Once the pool was finished, Jared started taking care of the cleaning and maintenance, and I was so happy with his work that I decided to keep using the service for regular upkeep. If you’re in Hurst and need pool service, I highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: danny miranda

reviews.text: we decided to get a fiberglass pool installed at our home in hurst, and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. wayne responded quickly to our first call and helped us figure out the best pool layout and features for our backyard. after we agreed on everything, the team kept us updated and even moved up our installation date, which was a nice surprise. marvin and his crew showed up and installed the pool in just two days. they did a fantastic job, making sure everything was in the right place and the pool was ready to go. even though it was hot outside, the team worked hard and kept everything on schedule. after the pool was in, harold and his team handled the electrical work and concrete, and everything turned out perfect. the finishing touches, like the coping and pool cleaning, were done by another crew, and they made sure the pool was spotless and ready for us to use. all the workers were friendly and always answered our questions. the entire job was well coordinated and finished in just over a month. overall, we are very happy with our new pool and the excellent service we received. i highly recommend this pool cleaning and installation company to anyone in hurst looking for great work and friendly staff.
reviews.author: caitlin jennings

reviews.text: We had a great experience with this pool service company! They handled a full remodel of our pool and did an amazing job from start to finish. Wayne guided us through every step, making sure we understood what was happening and always delivering on what was promised. When we noticed a minor issue later, we gave them a call. They responded quickly, checked things out, and took care of the repair right away—you can't even tell there was ever a problem. Since the remodel, we've also started using their weekly pool cleaning services. The team does a fantastic job keeping our pool sparkling clean, even during the hot Texas summers. For years, we thought our pool was always having algae problems because of bad water, but now it's clear and perfect all the time. We just needed the right pool service! Highly recommend them for anyone looking for reliable pool care.
reviews.author: rachael casey

reviews.text: If you’re searching for a reliable pool service in Hurst, look no further—Hurst Pool Service is the team you want! After dealing with several pool companies in the past, I can honestly say the customer care here stands out above the rest. Nathan was our project manager and did an outstanding job from start to finish. As soon as our permit was ready, the crew got started and finished building and filling our pool in just six weeks. Now, a few months later, everything is working perfectly. The workers were always professional and made sure to keep our property tidy throughout the process. We’re thrilled with our new pool and love spending time in it, especially with the Texas heat. The whole experience was fantastic.
reviews.author: I Braun

reviews.text: We had our pool re-plastered and re-tiled, and the results are fantastic. The pool looks amazing and fresh, and we've already told several friends in Hurst about the great service. The crew, especially Marvin, was skilled, efficient, and always friendly. Every day, they made sure the pool area was clean and well taken care of. The pricing was fair compared to other pool companies, and the whole experience was smooth from start to finish. If you need pool refinishing or other pool services, we definitely recommend this team!
reviews.author: Colin28 G

reviews.text: Conner and his team were super friendly and professional. They did a great job cleaning our pool and made sure it was sparkling and ready to use in no time. Conner patiently explained all the steps for keeping our pool water clear and taught us some helpful pool care tips. If you're in Hurst and want reliable and thorough pool cleaning, this is the company to call. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: E Strickland
